name: korture
description: KORTURE.ai Sense. It reads your chats with AI on your own Mac, with your own AI, and shows one number out of 100, the three parts behind it and the nine moves. Type /korture for your reading.

interface.shortDescription: How you work with AI, measured
interface.longDescription: KORTURE measures how you work with AI, helps you understand the patterns, and builds an AI setup around how you want to improve. Its hooks start a reading when a chat ends and tell you once when there is news.
